privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what happens to the data you send through the contact form on this website.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.p1: Your personal data is controlled by Jacek Kozłowski. For any data-related matters, write to {{email}}.

data.title: What data I collect
data.p1: Through the contact form you send me:
data.l1: your name, email address, topic and message,
data.l2: depending on the topic: budget range, timeline and a link to materials, or company name, position and type of contract,
data.l3: technical information: the page the form was sent from and the site language.

purpose.title: Purpose and legal basis
purpose.p1: I process the data only to:
purpose.l1: reply to your message and continue the conversation (Art. 6(1)(a) and (f) GDPR — consent and legitimate interest),
purpose.l2: prepare a quote or proposal at your request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — steps prior to entering into a contract),
purpose.l3: for long-term collaboration proposals — reply and discuss the details.

processors.title: Who receives the data
processors.p1: I don't sell or share data for marketing. I use services that process data on my behalf:
processors.l1: EmailJS (EmailJS Pte. Ltd.) — delivers the form content to my inbox; it acts as a processor and data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area under standard contractual clauses,
processors.l2: my email provider (Google — Gmail), where the correspondence is stored,
processors.l3: GitHub (GitHub Pages) — website hosting; the server may record IP addresses in technical logs.

retention.title: How long I keep the data
retention.p1: I keep messages for as long as the conversation lasts and then no longer than 12 months after the last contact. If we start working together, data may be kept longer — as long as the law requires (e.g. tax regulations).
retention.p2: The history of sent messages in the EmailJS dashboard is kept according to the EmailJS account settings and deleted no later than after the period above.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.l1: access your data and get a copy of it,
rights.l3: request erasure or restriction of processing,
rights.l4: object to processing and port your data,
rights.l5: withdraw consent — without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal,
rights.l6: lodge a complaint with the Polish supervisory authority, the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (uodo.gov.pl).

voluntary.title: Providing data is voluntary
voluntary.p1: Providing data is voluntary, but without your name, email address and message I can't reply. I don't make automated decisions or use profiling.

storage.title: Cookies and browser storage
storage.p1: This website doesn't use analytics or advertising cookies. It only stores the selected site language in your browser's storage (localStorage).
storage.p2: YouTube videos load in privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com) only after you click play — Google's privacy policy applies from that point.
